G5088.def:
**τίκτω **
[in LXX chiefly for יָלַד ;]
prop., of parents,
to beget, bring forth, but esp. the latter, and so always in NT: absol., [[Luk.1.57; 2.6|Luk.1:57 2:6]], [[Jhn.16.21|Jhn.16:21]], [[Gal.4.27|Gal.4:27]]" (LXX) (see M, _Pr._, 127), [[Rev.12.2|Rev.12:2]], 4; υἱόν, [[Mat.1.21, 23; 1.25|Mat.1:21, 23 1:25]] [[Luk.1.31; 2.7|Luk.1:31 2:7]], [[Rev.12.5, 13|Rev.12:5, 13]]; pass., [[Mat.2.2|Mat.2:2]], [[Luk.2.11|Luk.2:11]]. Metaphorical, of the earth, βοτάνην, [[Heb.6.7|Heb.6:7]] (Æsch., al.); of lust, ἁμαρτίαν, [[Jas.1.15|Jas.1:15]]†
(AS)

G5015.def:
**ταράσσω **
[in LXX for בָּהַל, רָגַז, etc., forty-six words in all ;]
**to disturb, trouble, stir up**: primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, [[Jhn.1.5|Jhn.1:5]] [4], [[Jhn.1.7|Jhn.1:7]] Metaphorical, of the mind (Æsch., Plat., al.), **to trouble, disquiet, perplex**: [[Act.15.24|Act.15:24]], [[Gal.1.7; 5.10|Gal.1:7 5:10]]; ἑαυτόν (troubled himself; Westc., in l), [[Jhn.11.33|Jhn.11:33]] of a crowd, to stir up, [[Act.17.8, 13|Act.17:8, 13]]; pass., [[Mat.2.3; 14.26|Mat.2:3 14:26]], [[Mrk.6.50|Mrk.6:50]], [[Luk.1.12; 24.38|Luk.1:12 24:38]], [[Jhn.12.27|Jhn.12:27]] ([[Psa.6.4|Psa.6:4]]) [[Psa.14.1|Psa.14:1]], 7, [[1Pe.3.14|1Pe.3:14]]" (LXX) ; τ. πνεύματι, [[Jhn.13.21|Jhn.13:21]] (cf. δια-, ἐκ-ταράσσω)
(AS)

G5054.def:
**τελευτή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(τελέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת, מָוֶת ;]
1. a finishing.
2. **an end**: τ. βίου (Hdt., al.): also without βίου, the end of life, **death **(Hdt., Plat., al.): [[Mat.2.15|Mat.2:15]]†
(AS)

G5053.def:
**τελευτάω**, -ῶ
(τελευτή), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;]
1. trans., to complete, finish; esp. τ. τ. αἰῶνα, τ. βίον, to complete life, to die (Æsch., Hdt., al.).
2. Intrans., **to come to an end, hence, to die **(Hdt., al.): [[Mat.2.19; 9.18; 22.25|Mat.2:19 9:18 22:25]], [[Mrk.9.48|Mrk.9:48]], [[Luk.7.2|Luk.7:2]], [[Jhn.11.39|Jhn.11:39]], [[Act.2.29; 7.15|Act.2:29 7:15]], [[Heb.11.22|Heb.11:22]]; Hebraistically, θανάτῳ τελευτάτω (מוּת, [[Exo.21.17|Exo.21:17]]), [[Mat.15.4|Mat.15:4]], [[Mrk.7.10|Mrk.7:10]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5062.def:
**τεσσεράκοντα** (Rec. τεσσαρ-, v, WH, _App._, 150; M, _Pr._, 45 f.; Thackeray, _Gr._, 62 f., 73 f.), οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl.,
**forty**: [[Mat.4.2|Mat.4:2]], [[Mrk.1.13|Mrk.1:13]], [[Luk.4.2|Luk.4:2]], [[Jhn.2.20|Jhn.2:20]], [[Act.1.3|Act.1:3]], al
(AS)

G5087.def:
**τίθημι**,
[in LXX for שִׁית ,נתן ,שׂוּם, etc. ;]
1. causative of κεῖμαι,
(a) **to place, lay, set**: [[Luk.6.48|Luk.6:48]], [[Rom.9.33|Rom.9:33]], al.; of laying the dead to rest, [[Mrk.15.47|Mrk.15:47]], [[Luk.23.55|Luk.23:55]], [[Jhn.11.34|Jhn.11:34]], [[Act.7.16|Act.7:16]], al.; before ἐπί, with genitive, [[Luk.8.16|Luk.8:16]], [[Jhn.19.19|Jhn.19:19]], al.; id. with accusative, [[Mrk.4.21|Mrk.4:21]], [[2Co.3.13|2Co.3:13]], al.; ὑπό, [[Mat.5.15|Mat.5:15]], al.; παρά, [[Act.4.35, 37|Act.4:35, 37]]. Mid., **to have put or placed, to place for oneself**: of putting in prison, [[Act.4.3; 5.18, 25|Act.4:3, 5:18, 25]], al.; of giving counsel, βουλήν, [[Acts.27.12|Act.27:12]]; of laying up in one's heart, [[Luk.1.66; 21.14|Luk.1:66 21:14]] ( [[1Sa.21.12|1Ki.21:12]]);
(b) **to put down, lay down**: of bending the knees, τ. γόνατα, **to kneel**, [[Mrk.15.19|Mrk.15:19]], [[Act.7.60|Act.7:60]], al.; of putting off garments, [[Jhn.13.4|Jhn.13:4]] of laying down life, τ. ψυχήν, [[Jhn.10.11, 15, 17, 18; 13.37, 38; 15.13|Jhn.10:11, 15 17, 18 13:37, 38 15:13]], [[1Jn.3.16|1Jn.3:16]]; of laying by money, παρ ̓ ἑαυτῷ, [[1Co.16.2|1Co.16:2]] of setting on food, [[Jhn.2.10|Jhn.2:10]] metaphorically, of setting forth an idea in symbolism, [[Mrk.4.30|Mrk.4:30]]
2. **to set, fix, establish**: ὑπόδειγμα, [[2Pe.2.6|2Pe.2:6]]
3. **to make, appoint**: [[Mat.22.44|Mat.22:44]], [[Mrk.12.36|Mrk.12:36]], [[Luk.20.43|Luk.20:43]], [[Act.2.35|Act.2:35]], [[Rom.4.17|Rom.4:17]], al. Mid., **to make, set** or **appoint for oneself**: [[Act.20.28|Act.20:28]], [[1Co.12.28|1Co.12:28]], [[1Th.5.9|1Th.5:9]], [[1Ti.1.12|1Ti.1:12]], al.; before ἵνα, [[Jhn.15.16|Jhn.15:16]] (cf . ἀνα-, προσ-ανα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἀντι-δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπο-τίθημι).
(AS)

G5036.def:
**ταχύς**, -εῖα, -ύ
[in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;]
**quick, swift, speedy**: opposite to βραδύς, Ja 119.†
(AS)

G5057.def:
**τελώνης**, -ου, ὁ
(τέλος, ὠνέομαι)
1. a farmer of taxes (Let. publicanus).
2. **A subordinate of the former, who collected taxes or tolls in a particular district, a tax-gatherer **(EV, publican): [[Mat.5.46; 10.3|Mat.5:46 10:3]], [[Luk.3.12; 5.27, 29; 7.29; 18.10-11, 13|Luk.3:12 5:27, 29 7:29 18:10-11, 13]]; pl., τ. κ. ἁμαρτωλοί, [[Mat.9.10-11; 11.19|Mat.9:10-11 11:19]], [[Mrk.2.15-16|Mrk.2:15-16]], [[Luk.5.30; 7.34; 15.1|Luk.5:30 7:34 15:1]]; τ. κ. πόρναι, [[Mat.21.31-32;|Mat.21:31-32]] ὁ ἐθνικὸς κ. ὁ τ., [[Mat.18.17|Mat.18:17]] (cf. _DB_, iv, 172; _ext._, 394 f.; MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G5046.def:
**τέλειος**, -α, -ον
(τέλος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלֵם, תָּמִים and cogn. forms ;]
**having reached its end, finished, mature, complete, perfect**;
1. of persons, primarily of physical development,
(a) **full-grown, mature**: [[Heb.5.14|Heb.5:14]] ethically: [[Php.3.15|Php.3:15]] opposite to νήπιος (-άζειν), [[1Co.2.6; 14.20|1Co.2:6 14:20]], [[Eph.4.13|Eph.4:13]]; τ. καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι, [[Col.4.12|Col.4:12]] τ. ἐν Χριστῷ, [[Col.1.28|Col.1:28]]
(b) complete, perfect (expressing the simple idea of complete goodness, without reference either to maturity or to the philosophical idea of a τέλος; see Hort on [[Jas.1.4|Jas.1:4]]): [[Mat.5.48; 19.21|Mat.5:48 19:21]], [[Jas.1.4; 3.2|Jas.1:4 3:2]]; of God, [[Mat.5.48|Mat.5:48]]
2. **Of things, complete, perfect**: [[Rom.12.2|Rom.12:2]] ἔργον, [[Jas.1.4|Jas.1:4]] νόμος, [[Jas.1.25|Jas.1:25]] δώρημα, [[Jas.1.17|Jas.1:17]] ἀγάπη, [[1Jn.4.18|1Jn.4:18]] τὸ τ., [[1Co.13.10|1Co.13:10]] compar., τελειοτέρα (σκηνή), [[Heb.9.11|Heb.9:11]]
(There is probably no reference in St. Paul's usage to the use of this term in the ancient mysteries; cf. _ICC_ on [[Col.1.28|Col.1:28]] but see also Lft., in l, and _Notes_, 173 f.) †
_SYN._: see: ὁλόκληρος (and cf. Rendall, He., 158 ff.) (AS)

G5009.def:
**ταμεῖον**
(late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, _Pr._, 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, _Gr._, 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό, [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר ;]
1. a treasury (Thuc., al).
2. a store-chamber (Arist., Xen.; [[Deu.28.8|Deu.28:8]]): [[Luk.12.24|Luk.12:24]].
3. an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 [[Isa.26.20|Isa.26:20]], al.): [[Mat.6.6; 24.26|Mat.6:6 24:26]], [[Luk.12.3|Luk.12:3]].†
(AS)

G5058.def:
**τελώνιον**, -ου, τό
(τελώνης),
a custom house (so in M_Gr._), tollhouse, place of toll: [[Mat.9.9|Mat.9:9]], [[Mrk.2.14|Mrk.2:14]], [[Luk.5.27|Luk.5:27]].†
(AS)

G5056.def:
**τέλος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX for קֵץ, etc.; εἰς τὸ τ., chiefly for נֶצַח and cognate forms ;]
1. **end**: most frequently of the termination or limit of an act or state (in NT also of the end of a period of time, cl. τελευτή), [[Luk.1.33|Luk.1:33]], [[1Co.10.11|1Co.10:11]], [[2Co.3.13|2Co.3:13]], [[1Pe.4.7|1Pe.4:7]]; by meton., of one who makes an end, [[Rom.10.4|Rom.10:4]] ἕως (ἄχρι, μέκρι) τέλους, [[1Co.1.8|1Co.1:8]], [[2Co.1.13|2Co.1:13]], [[Heb.3.14; 6.11|Heb.3:14 6:11]], [[Rev.2.26|Rev.2:26]]; εἰς τ., to or at the end, [[Mat.10.22|Mat.10:22]], [[Mrk.13.13|Mrk.13:13]], [[Luk.18.5|Luk.18:5]], [[Jhn.13.1|Jhn.13:1]] (or here, to the uttermost, see Westc., in l); τ. ἔχειν, [[Luk.22.37|Luk.22:37]] adverbially, τὸ δὲ τέλος, finally, [[1Pe.3.8|1Pe.3:8]] of the last in a series, [[Rev.21.6; 22.13|Rev.21:6 22:13]]; of the issue, fate or destiny, [[Mat.26.58|Mat.26:58]] with genitive of thing(s), [[Rom.6.21|Rom.6:21]], al.; with genitive of person(s), [[2Co.11.13|2Co.11:13]], al.; of the aim or purpose, [[1Ti.1.5|1Ti.1:5]]
2. **toll, custom, revenue**: [[Rom.13.7|Rom.13:7]] pl., as most usually, [[Mat.17.25|Mat.17:25]]
(AS)

G5011.def:
**ταπεινός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for שָׁפָל, עָנִי, etc. ;]
**low-lying**; metaphorically,
(a) **lowly, of low degree, brought low**: [[Jas.1.9|Jas.1:9]], [[2Co.7.6|2Co.7:6]] (cf. [[Sir.25.23|Sir.25:23]]); οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, [[Luk.1.52|Luk.1:52]] τ. ταπεινοῖς (neut., R, txt.; masc., R, mg.; see _ICC_, in l), [[Rom.12.16|Rom.12:16]]
(b) lowly in spirit, humble, in cl. usually in a slighting sense (see Tr., _Syn._, § xlii; but see also Abbott, _Essays_, 81), in NT in an honourable sense: [[2Co.10.1|2Co.10:1]] before τ. καρδίᾳ, [[Mat.11.29|Mat.11:29]] (cf. [[Psa.34.19|Psa.34:19]]); opposite to ὑπερήφανος, [[Jas.4.6|Jas.4:6]], [[1Pe.5.5|1Pe.5:5]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5089.def:
**τίλλω **
[in LXX: [[Est.9.3|Est.9:3]], [[Isa.18.7|Isa.18:7]], Dan LXX 7:4 (מָרַט) * ;]
**to pluck, pluck off**: στάχυας, [[Mat.12.1|Mat.12:1]], [[Mrk.2.23|Mrk.2:23]], [[Luk.6.1|Luk.6:1]].†
(AS)

G5045.def:
**τέκτων**, -ονος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חָרָשׁ ;]
an artificer in wood, stone or metal, but esp. a carpenter (see MM, xxiv): [[Mat.13.55|Mat.13:55]], [[Mrk.6.3|Mrk.6:3]].†
(AS)

G5076.def:
**τετραάρχης** (Rec. τετράρχης, see supr.), -ου, ὁ
(τετρα- in corp. = τέτορα, Doric for τέσσαρα, + ἄρχω),
a tetrarch, i.e.
(a) prop., the governor of a fourth part of a region (Strab.);
(b) **any petty ruler **(Plut.); in NT, of Herod Antipas: [[Mat.14.1|Mat.14:1]], [[Luk.3.19; 9.7|Luk.3:19 9:7]], [[Act.13.1|Act.13:1]].†
(AS)

G5091.def:
**τιμάω**, -ῶ
(τιμή), [in LXX for כָּבַד pi., עָרַךְ hi., etc. ;]
1. to fix the value, **price**: with accusative of person(s), of Christ, [[Mat.27.9|Mat.27:9]] (LXX).
2. **to honour**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.15.4|Mat.15:4]] (LXX), [[Mat.15.5|Mat.15:5]], 8" (LXX) [[Mat.19.19|Mat.19:19]] (LXX), [[Mrk.7.6, 10; 10.19|Mrk.7:6, 10 10:19]], [[Luk.18.28|Luk.18:28]]" (LXX), [[Jhn.5.23; 8.49; 12.26|Jhn.5:23 8:49 12:26]], [[Eph.6.2|Eph.6:2]]" (LXX), [[1Ti.5.3|1Ti.5:3]], [[1Pe.2.17|1Pe.2:17]]; πολλαῖς τιμαῖς, [[Act.28.10|Act.28:10]]†
(AS)

G5013.def:
**ταπεινόω**, -ῶ
(ταπεινός), [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה, also for שָׁפֵל, כָּנַע, etc. ;]
**to make low**: ὄρος (βουνόν), [[Luk.3.5|Luk.3:5]] (LXX). Metaphorical, **to humble, abase**: [[Mat.18.4; 23.12|Mat.18:4 23:12]], [[Luk.14.11; 18.14|Luk.14:11 18:14]], [[2Co.11.7; 12.21|2Co.11:7 12:21]], [[Php.2.8|Php.2:8]]; pass., [[Mat.23.12|Mat.23:12]], [[Luk.14.11; 18.14|Luk.14:11 18:14]], [[Php.4.12|Php.4:12]]; id. with mid. sense, [[Jas.4.10|Jas.4:10]], [[1Pe.5.6|1Pe.5:6]].†
(AS)

G5007.def:
**τάλαντομ**, -ον, τ
[in LXX for כִּכָּר ;]
1. a balance (Hom.).
2. **that which is weighed, a talent**;
(a) **a talent in weight **(in Horn. always of gold);
(b) **a sum of money, whether gold or silver, equivalent to a talent in weight **(see _DB_, iii, 418 ff.): [[Mat.18.24; 25.15|Mat.18:24 25:15]] ff.†
(AS)

G5083.def:
**τηρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
1. **to watch over, guard, keep, preserve**: [[Mat.27.36|Mat.27:36]], [[Act.16.23|Act.16:23]], al.; ἑαυτόν, [[2Co.11.9|2Co.11:9]], [[1Ti.5.22|1Ti.5:22]], [[Jas.1.27|Jas.1:27]], [[Jude.21|Ju 21]]; before εἰς, [[Jhn.12.7|Jhn.12:7]], [[Act.25.21|Act.25:21]], [[1Pe.1.4|1Pe.1:4]], [[2Pe.2.4; 2.9; 3.7|2Pe.2:4 2:9 3:7]], [[Jude.6|Ju 6]]; ἐν, [[Jhn.17.11-12|Jhn.17:11-12]], [[Jude.21|Ju 21]]; ἐκ, [[Jhn.17.15|Jhn.17:15]], [[Rev.3.10|Rev.3:10]]; τ. πίστιν, [[2Ti.4.7|2Ti.4:7]], [[Rev.14.12|Rev.14:12]]; τ. ἑνότητα τ. πνεύματος, [[Eph.4.3|Eph.4:3]]
2. **to watch, give heed to, observe**: τ. σάββατον, [[Jhn.9.16|Jhn.9:16]] τ. ἐντολήν (-άς), [[Mat.19.17|Mat.19:17]], [[Jhn.14.15; 15.10|Jhn.14:15 15:10]], [[1Ti.6.14|1Ti.6:14]], [[1Jn.2.3-4|1Jn.2:3-4]] [[Jhn.3.22|Jn 3:22]] [[Jhn.3.24|Jn 3:24]] [[Jhn.5.3|Jn 5:3]], [[Rev.12.17; 14.12|Rev.12:17 14:12]]; τ. λόγον (-ους), [[Jhn.8.51-52, 55; 14.23-24; 15.20; 17.6|Jhn.8:51-52, 55 14:23-24 15:20 17:6]], [[1Jn.2.5|1Jn.2:5]], [[Rev.3.8, 10; 22.7, 9|Rev.3:8, 10 22:7, 9]]; τ. νόμον, [[Act.15.5|Act.15:5]], [[Jas.2.10|Jas.2:10]]; τ. παράδοσιν, [[Mrk.7.9|Mrk.7:9]] τ. ἔργα, [[Rev.2.26|Rev.2:26]] τ. γεγραμμένα, [[Rev.1.3|Rev.1:3]] (cf. δια-, παρα-, συν-τηρέω)
_SYN._: φυλάσσω, implying **custody and protection**: τ. expresses the idea of watchful care and "may mark the result of which φ. is the means" (Thayer see word) (AS)

G5037.def:
**τέ**,
_enclitic copulative particle_ (= Lat. -que as καί = and, ac, atque, not very frequently in NT, more than two-thirds of the occurrences being in _Ac. _
1. τέ solitarium, **and**, denoting a closer affinity than καί between words and sentences which it connects (BL, §77, 8): [[Mat.28.12|Mat.28:12]], [[Jhn.4.42|Jhn.4:42]], [[Act.2.33, 37, 40; 10.22; 11.21|Act.2:33, 37 40 10:22 11:21]], al.
2. Denoting a closer connection than simple καί, τὲ . . . καί, τὲ καί, τὲ . . . τέ ([[Act.26.16|Act.26:16]] [[Rom.14.8|Rom.14:8]]), **as well . . . as also, both . . . and**: [[Luk.12.45|Luk.12:45]], [[Act.1.1; 15.9, 21:30|Act.1:1 15:9, 21:30]], al.; τὲ . . . δέ, **and . . . and**, [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]] τὲ γάρ . . . ὁμοίως δὲ καί, [[Rom.1.26, 27|Rom.1:26, 27]].
(AS)

G5059.def:
**τέρας**, -ατος, τό
[in LXX chiefly for מוֹפֵת ;]
**a wonder, marvel**: in NT always pl., τ. κ. σημεῖα, [[Mat.24.24|Mat.24:24]], al. (see: σημεῖον)
(AS)

G5064.def:
**τέσσαρες**
(and Ion. and late -ερεν, and late accusative -εν; see WH, _App._, 150; M, _Pr._, 36, 45 f.), οἱ, αἱ, -αρα, τά, genitive, -ων,
**four**: [[Mat.24.31|Mat.24:31]], [[Mrk.2.3|Mrk.2:3]], [[Luk.2.37|Luk.2:37]], [[Jhn.11.17; 19.23|Jhn.11:17 19:23]], [[Act.10.11|Act.10:11]], [[Rev.4.4|Rev.4:4]], 6, al
(AS)

G5027.def:
**ταφή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(θάπτω), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַר and cognate forms ;]
**burial**: [[Mat.27.7|Mat.27:7]] (Hdt., al.; for other meanings, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 355 f., MM xxiv).†
(AS)

G5035.def:
**ταχύ**
(neut. of ταχύς),
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;]
**quickly, speedily, forthwith**: [[Mat.5.25; 28.7-8|Mat.5:25 28:7-8]], [[Mrk.9.39|Mrk.9:39]], [[Luk.15.22|Luk.15:22]], [[Jhn.11.29|Jhn.11:29]], [[Rev.2.16; 3.11; 11.14; 22.7, 12; 22.2|Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2]] o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): [[Jhn.13.27; 20.4|Jhn.13:27 20:4]], [[1Ti.3.14|1Ti.3:14]] (T, Rec.), [[Heb.13.19, 23|Heb.13:19, 23]] Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), [[Act.17.15|Act.17:15]]†
(AS)

G5021.def:
**τάσσω **
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם, also for צָוָה pi., נָתַן, etc. ;]
**primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order**: with dative (accusative) and inf. (Bl., § 72, 5), [[Act.15.2; 18.2|Act.15:2 18:2]] (διατ-, WH) [[Act.22.10|Act.22:10]] ἑαυτούς, [[1Co.16.15|1Co.16:15]] pass., [[Mat.8.9|Mat.8:9]] (T [WH], R, txt., om.), [[Luk.7.8|Luk.7:8]], [[Rom.13.1|Rom.13:1]]; ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον (perh. in mid. sense; see EGT and Page, in l), [[Act.13.48|Act.13:48]] mid., to appoint for oneself or by one's own authority, [[Mat.28.16|Mat.28:16]], [[Act.28.23|Act.28:23]].†
(AS)

G5008.def:
**ταλειθά** (Rec. ταλιθά), (Aram. טְלִיתָא, see Dalman, _Gr._, 150),
talitha, i.e. maiden: [[Mrk.5.41|Mrk.5:41]]†
(AS)

G5081.def:
**τηλαυγῶς **
_adv._ (τῆλε, afar, + αὐγή, radiance), poët. and in late prose,
**at a distance clearly**: [[Mrk.8.25|Mrk.8:25]] (W, mg., δηλαυγῶς).†
(AS)

G5090.def:
**Τιμαῖος**, -ου, ὁ (Aram. טִימַי (?), see Zorell, see word),
**Timæus**: [[Mrk.10.46|Mrk.10:46]]†
(AS)

G5010.def:
**τάξις**, -εως, ἡ
(τάσσω), [in LXX: [[Job.38.12|Job.38:12]] (מָקוֹם), [[Psa.110.4|Psa.110:4]] (דִּבְרָה), [[2Ma.9.18|2Ma.9:18]], al. ;]
1. an arranging, hence, in military sense, disposition of an army, battle array (Thuc., al.).
2. **arrangement, order **(Plat., al): [[Luk.1.8|Luk.1:8]]
3. **due order**: [[Col.2.5|Col.2:5]] (_ICC_, in l); κατὰ τάξιν, [[1Co.14.40|1Co.14:40]]
4. **office, order **(for exx., see MM, xxiv): [[Heb.5.6|Heb.5:6]] (LXX), [[Heb.5.6; 6.20; 7.11, 17|Heb.5:6 6:20 7:11, 17]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5050.def:
**τελείωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(τελειόω), [in LXX chiefly for מִלֻּא, [[Exo.29.22|Exo.29:22]], al. ;]
**fulfilment, completion, perfection**: [[Luk.1.45|Luk.1:45]], [[Heb.7.11|Heb.7:11]].†
(AS)

G5014.def:
**ταπείνωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ταπεινόω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;]
**abasement, humiliation, low estate**: [[Luk.1.48|Luk.1:48]], [[Act.8.33|Act.8:33]]" (LXX), [[Php.3.21|Php.3:21]], [[Jas.1.10|Jas.1:10]] (Plat., Arist., and later writers).†
(AS)

G5048.def:
**τελειόω**, -ῶ
(τέλειος), [in LXX: [[Exo.29.9|Exo.29:9]], [[Lev.4.5|Lev.4:5]], al. (τ. χεῖρ מָלֵא pi.), [[2Sa.22.26|2Ki.22:26]], al. (תָּמַם), [[Wis.4.13|Wis.4:13]], al. (cf. Westc., He., 64) ;]
1. **bring to an end, finish, accomplish, fulfil**: [[Jhn.4.34|Jhn.4:34]], [[Act.20.24|Act.20:24]]; of time, [[Luk.2.43|Luk.2:43]], [[Jhn.5.36; 17.4|Jhn.5:36 17:4]]; pass., ἡ γραφή, [[Jhn.19.28|Jhn.19:28]]
2. **to bring to maturity or completeness, to complete, perfect**;
(a) **of things**: [[Heb.7.19|Heb.7:19]], [[Jas.2.22|Jas.2:22]], [[1Jn.2.5|1Jn.2:5]] [[Jhn.4.12|Jn 4:12]] [[Jhn.4.17|Jn 4:17]] :
(b) **of persons, in ethical and spiritual sense**: [[Heb.2.10; 9.9; 10.1, 14|Heb.2:10 9:9 10:1, 14]]; pass., [[Luk.13.32|Luk.13:32]], [[Jhn.17.23|Jhn.17:23]], [[Php.3.12|Php.3:12]], [[Heb.5.9; 7.28; 11.40; 12.23|Heb.5:9 7:28 11:40 12:23]], [[1Jn.4.18|1Jn.4:18]] (for a different view of the meaning in [[Heb.2.10|Heb.2:10]], al., see Rendall, in l).†
(AS)

G5075.def:
**τετρααρχέω** (Rec. τετραρχ-; see WH, _App._, 145), -ῶ
(τετραάρχης),
**to be tetrarch**: with genitive, [[Luk.3.1|Luk.3:1]] (FlJ, BJ, iii, 10, 7).†
(AS)

G5052.def:
**τελεσφορέω**, -ῶ
(τέλος, φέρω) [in LXX: [[4Ma.13.20|4Ma.13:20]] * ;]
(a) of plants, **to bring fruit to perfection **(Theophr.): [[Luk.8.14|Luk.8:14]]
(b) of females, to bear perfect offspring (Artemid.; 4Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G5030.def:
**ταχέως**
(ταχύς)
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for מְהֵרָה and cognate forms ;]
**quickly, hastily**: [[Luk.14.21; 16.6|Luk.14:21 16:6]], [[Jhn.11.31|Jhn.11:31]], [[1Co.4.19|1Co.4:19]], [[Php.2.19, 24|Php.2:19, 24]], [[2Ti.4.9|2Ti.4:9]]; with suggestion of rashness, [[Gal.1.6|Gal.1:6]], [[2Th.2.2|2Th.2:2]], [[1Ti.5.22|1Ti.5:22]].†
(AS)

G5034.def:
**τάχος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of מָהַר ;]
swiftness, speed. Adverbially, ἐν τ. (ταχέως), **quickly, speedily, soon**: [[Luk.18.8|Luk.18:8]], [[Act.12.7; 22.18; 25.4|Act.12:7 22:18 25:4]], [[Rom.16.20|Rom.16:20]], [[1Ti.3.14|1Ti.3:14]], [[Rev.1.1; 22.6|Rev.1:1 22:6]].†
(AS)

G5072.def:
**τετράμηνος**, -ον
[in LXX (neut.): [[Jdg.19.2|Jdg.19:2]] A [[Jdg.20.47|Jdg.20:47]] A (עַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים ) * ;]
**of four months, four months**; as subst., τ. (sc. ὥρα, but neut. in Rec.), [[Jhn.4.35|Jhn.4:35]] (Thuc., al.).†
(AS)

G5085.def:
**Τιβεριάς**, -άδος, ἡ
(Τιβέριος),
**Tiberias**, a city of Galilee: [[Jhn.6.23|Jhn.6:23]], [[Jhn.6.1; 21.1|Jhn.6:1 21:1]] (cf Γεννησσαρέτ, Γαλιλαία).†
(AS)

G5066.def:
**τεταρταῖος**, -α, -ον
(τέταρτος), [in LXX: [[2Sa.3.4|2Ki.3:4]] A (רְבִיעִי) * ;]
**of or on the fourth day**: τ. εἶναι (Hdt., τ. γενέσθαι), to be four days dead, [[Jhn.11.39|Jhn.11:39]]†
(AS)

G5032.def:
**τάχειον**, see: ταχύ.
**ταχύ**
(neut. of ταχύς),
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;]
**quickly, speedily, forthwith**: [[Mat.5.25; 28.7-8|Mat.5:25 28:7-8]], [[Mrk.9.39|Mrk.9:39]], [[Luk.15.22|Luk.15:22]], [[Jhn.11.29|Jhn.11:29]], [[Rev.2.16; 3.11; 11.14; 22.7, 12; 22.2|Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2]] o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): [[Jhn.13.27; 20.4|Jhn.13:27 20:4]], [[1Ti.3.14|1Ti.3:14]] (T, Rec.), [[Heb.13.19, 23|Heb.13:19, 23]] Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), [[Act.17.15|Act.17:15]]†
(AS)

G5040.def:
**τεκνίον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of τέκνον),
**a little child**: as a term of endearment, in voc. pl., [[Jhn.13.33|Jhn.13:33]], [[Gal.4.19|Gal.4:19]], [[1Jn.2.1|1Jn.2:1]] [[Jhn.2.12|Jn 2:12]] [[Jhn.2.28|Jn 2:28]] [[Jhn.3.7|Jn 3:7]] [[Jhn.3.13|Jn 3:13]] [[Jhn.4.4|Jn 4:4]] [[Jhn.5.21|Jn 5:21]].†
(AS)

G5039.def:
**τεκμήριον**, -ου, τό
(τέκμαρ, a mark, sign), [in LXX: [[Wis.5.4; 19.13|Wis.5:4 19:13]], [[3Ma.3.24|3Ma.3:24]] * ;]
**a sure sign, a positive proof**: [[Act.1.1-26|Act.1:1-26]] (for exx., see MM, xxiv).†
_SYN._: ἔνδειγμα, q.v (AS)

G5084.def:
**τήρησις**, -εως, ἡ
(τηρέω), [in LXX: [[Wis.6.18|Wis.6:18]], ([[Sir.32.23|Sir.32:23]]), [[1Ma.5.18|1Ma.5:18]], [[2Ma.3.40|2Ma.3:40]], [[3Ma.5.44|3Ma.5:44]] * ;]
1. **a watching, hence, imprisonment, ward **(see Deiss., BS, 267): [[Act.4.3; 5.18|Act.4:3 5:18]].
2. **a keeping**: τ. ἐντολῶν (cf. Sir, Wis, ll. with, and see Westc. on [[1Jn.2.3|1Jn.2:3]]), [[1Co.7.19|1Co.7:19]].†
(AS)

G5093.def:
**τίμιος**, -α, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX chiefly for יָקָר ;]
**valued, hence, **
(a) **precious, costly, highly valued**: primarily, of money value, λίθος, [[Rev.17.4; 18.12, 16; 21.19|Rev.17:4 18:12, 16 21:19]]; pl., [[1Co.3.12|1Co.3:12]] compar., -ώτεφος, [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]], Rec.; superl., -ώτατος, [[Rev.18.12; 21.11|Rev.18:12 21:11]]; in extended sense, καρπός, [[Jas.5.7|Jas.5:7]] αἷμα, [[1Pe.1.19|1Pe.1:19]] ἐπαγγέλματα, [[2Pe.1.4|2Pe.1:4]]
(b) **held in honour, honoured, esteemed worthy**: with dative, [[Act.5.34|Act.5:34]] ὁ γάμος, [[Heb.13.4|Heb.13:4]] ψυχή, [[Act.20.24|Act.20:24]] (where τ. is pleonastic, see Page, in l).†
(AS)

G5063.def:
**τεσσερακονταετίς**
(Τ, -έτης; Rec. τεσσαρ-, see supr.), -ές
**of forty years, forty years old**: [[Act.7.23; 13.18|Act.7:23 13:18]].†
(AS)

G5038.def:
**τεῖχος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹמָה ;]
a wall, esp. that about a town: [[Act.9.25|Act.9:25]], [[2Co.11.33|2Co.11:33]], [[Heb.11.30|Heb.11:30]], [[Rev.21.12-19|Rev.21:12-19]] †
(AS)

G5000.def:
**Ταβειθά** (Rec. Ταβιθά), ἡ (Aram. טַבְיְתָא or טְבִיתָא),
**Tabitha**: [[Act.9.36, 40|Act.9:36, 40]] (cf. Δορκάς).†
(AS)

G5074.def:
**τετρά-πους**, -ουν
[in LXX chiefly for בְּהֵמָה ;]
**four-footed**: of beasts, neut. pl., [[Act.10.12; 11.6|Act.10:12 11:6]], [[Rom.1.23|Rom.1:23]].†
(AS)

G5069.def:
**τετράδιον**, ου, τό
**a quarternion, a group of four**: στρατιωτῶν, [[Act.12.4|Act.12:4]] (Philo).
(AS)

G5017.def:
**τάραχος**, -ου, ὁ
(ταράσσω), [in LXX for מְהוּמָה, etc. ;]
**later form of ταραχή **(Xen., al.; see Thackeray, _Gr._, 159): [[Act.12.18; 19.23|Act.12:18 19:23]].†
(AS)

G5078.def:
**τέχνη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for חׇכְמָה, מַעֲשֶׂה, עֲבֹדָה ;]
**art, craft, trade**: [[Act.17.29; 18.3|Act.17:29 18:3]], [[Rev.18.22|Rev.18:22]] (WH, R, mg., om.).†
(AS)

G5079.def:
**τεχνίτης**, -ου, ὁ
(τέχνη), [in LXX for חָרָשׁ, etc. ;]
**a craftsman, artificer**: [[Act.19.24, 38|Act.19:24, 38]], [[Rev.18.22|Rev.18:22]]; of God ([[Wis.13.1|Wis.13:1]]), [[Heb.11.10|Heb.11:10]].†
_SYN._: δημιουργός, which see, and cf. Tr., _Syn._, § cv (AS)

G5012.def:
**ταπεινοφροσύνη**, -ης, ἡ
(ταπεινόφρων)
**lowliness of mind, humility**: [[Act.20.19|Act.20:19]], [[Eph.4.2|Eph.4:2]], [[Php.2.3|Php.2:3]], [[Col.3.12|Col.3:12]], [[1Pe.5.5|1Pe.5:5]]; of a false humility, [[Col.2.18, 23|Col.2:18, 23]] (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., _Syn._, § xlii).†
(AS)

G5097.def:
**τιμωρέω**, -ῶ
(τιμή + οὖρος, a guardian) [in LXX: [[Ezk.5.17; 14.15|Eze.5:17 14:15]] (שָׁכֹל pi), [[Wis.12.20; 18.8|Wis.12:20 18:8]], al. ;]
1. to help.
2. **to avenge**; mid., **to avenge oneself on, punish **(Hdt., Eur., al): act, in this sense, [[Act.22.5; 26.11|Act.22:5 26:11]] (see MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G5004.def:
**ταλαιπωρία**, -ας, ἡ
(ταλαίπωρος) [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁד ;]
1. hard work (Hippocr.).
2. **hardship, suffering, distress**: [[Rom.3.16|Rom.3:16]] (LXX) pl., [[Jas.5.1|Jas.5:1]] (see B1., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, _Mk._, 153).
(Hdt., Thuc., al.; and cf. MM, xxiv.)†
(AS)

G5005.def:
**ταλαίωρος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Psa.137.8|Psa.137:8]] (שָׁדַד), [[Isa.33.1|Isa.33:1]] (ποιεῖν τ., שָׁדַד), [[Tob.13.10|Tob.13:10]], [[Wis.3.11|Wis.3:11]], al. ;]
**distressed, miserable, wretched**: [[Rom.7.24|Rom.7:24]], [[Rev.3.17|Rev.3:17]].†
(AS)

G5001.def:
**τάγμα**, -τος, τό
(τάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּגֶל, also for חַי, רַגְלִי ;]
**that which has been arranged or placed in order**; esp. as military term, **a company, troop, division, rank**: metaphorically, [[1Co.15.23|1Co.15:23]] (see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G5082.def:
**τηλικοῦτος**, -αύτη, -οῦτο
(altern. of τηλικόσδε, -ήδε, -όνδε, strength­ened form of τηλίκος), [in LXX: [[2Ma.12.3|2Ma.12:3]], [[3Ma.3.9|3Ma.3:9]], [[4Ma.16.4|4Ma.16:4]] * ;]
1. of persons,
(a) **of such an age, so old**;
(b) so young.
2. **Of things, so great**: [[2Co.1.10|2Co.1:10]], [[Heb.2.3|Heb.2:3]], [[Jas.3.4|Jas.3:4]], [[Rev.16.18|Rev.16:18]].†
(AS)

G5099.def:
**τίνω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.27.12|Pro.27:12]] (τ. ζημίαν, for עָנַשׁ ni.), etc. ;]
**to pay**: t. δίκην (cf. Pr, l.with), to pay penalty, [[2Th.1.9|2Th.1:9]] (see M, _Th._, in l).†
(AS)

G5044.def:
**τεκνο-τροφέω**, -ῶ
to rear young (of bees, Arist.),
**to bring up children**: [[1Ti.5.10|1Ti.5:10]]†
(AS)

G5098.def:
**τιμωρία**, -ας, ἡ
(τιμωρέω), [in LXX: [[Pro.24.22|Pro.24:22]] (פִּיד), etc. ;]
1. help, assistance.
2. **vengeance, punishment**: [[Heb.10.29|Heb.10:29]]†
_SYN._: κόλασις, which see, and cf. MM, xxiv (AS)

G5003.def:
**ταλαιπωρέω**, -ῶ
(ταλαίπωρος), [in LXX Chiefly for שָׁדַד pu. ;]
1. **to do hard labour, suffer hardship or distress**: [[Jas.4.9|Jas.4:9]]
2. In cl. occasionally trans., to weary, distress (so [[Psa.17.9|Psa.17:9]], [[Isa.33.1|Isa.33:1]]).†
(AS)

G5020.def:
**ταρταρόω**, -ῶ
(Τάρταρος, a Greek name for the underworld, esp. the abode of the damned),
**to cast into hell**: [[2Pe.2.4|2Pe.2:4]] (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G5080.def:
**τήκω **
[in LXX for מָסַס ni., מָקַק ni., מוּג ni., etc. ;]
trans.,
**to melt, melt down**; pass., **to melt, melt away**: [[2Pe.3.12|2Pe.3:12]]†
(AS)

G5068.def:
**τετράγωνος**, -ον
(τετρα-, see supr., + γωνία), [in LXX for רָבַע and cogn. forms ;]
**square**: [[Rev.21.16|Rev.21:16]] (Hdt., Plat., al.).†
(AS)
